files.name: IdCard.vue
Cara Pakai.vue
files.content:
<!-- 1. Copy IdCard.vue ke components/ -->
<!-- 2. Gunakan di page mana saja: -->

<template>
  <IdCard
    name="CehaDev"
    role="Web Developer"
    badge="Available"
    photo="/foto-profil.jpg"
    :facts="[
      { label: 'Lokasi', value: 'Indonesia' },
      { label: 'Email', value: 'hi@cehadev.id' },
      { label: 'Website', value: 'cehadev.id' }
    ]"
    footer-text="cehadev.id"
    hint="Geser ID card ke mana saja"
  />
</template>

<!-- Props yang tersedia:
  name       — Nama di kartu (default: 'Your Name')
  role       — Jabatan/role (default: 'Your Role')
  badge      — Status badge hijau (default: 'Available')
  photo      — URL foto profil
  photoAlt   — Alt text foto
  facts      — Array [{icon, label, value}] untuk info
  footerText — Text di footer kartu
  hint       — Teks hint di bawah kartu
  uid        — Unique ID untuk SVG gradients (auto-generated)

Slots:
  default    — Ganti bagian facts dengan custom content
  photo      — Ganti area foto dengan custom content
  footer     — Ganti footer dengan custom content
-->

overview.id:
ID Card Lanyard adalah komponen Vue.js interaktif yang menampilkan kartu identitas digital dengan tali lanyard SVG yang fleksibel. Ketika pengguna menggeser kartu, tali lanyard secara real-time mengikuti pergerakan menggunakan cubic bezier paths yang dihitung dinamis.

Komponen ini menggabungkan beberapa teknik frontend tingkat lanjut: drag physics dengan rubber-band resistance, spring-back animation, 3D perspective tilt, dan SVG path computation. Semuanya berjalan di 60fps tanpa library eksternal — murni Vue 3 Composition API + CSS.

Dirancang sebagai komponen reusable yang bisa dipasang di project mana saja. Cukup pass props (nama, role, foto, facts) dan komponen langsung siap digunakan.
overview.en:
ID Card Lanyard is an interactive Vue.js component that displays a digital identity card with a flexible SVG lanyard rope. When users drag the card, the lanyard dynamically follows using cubic bezier paths computed in real-time.

The component combines several advanced frontend techniques: drag physics with rubber-band resistance, spring-back animation, 3D perspective tilt, and SVG path computation. Everything runs at 60fps with no external libraries — pure Vue 3 Composition API + CSS.

Designed as a reusable component for any project. Just pass props (name, role, photo, facts) and it's ready to use.

desc.id: Rubber-band resistance + spring-back dengan overshoot natural.
desc.en: Rubber-band resistance + spring-back with natural overshoot.

desc.id: Tali SVG cubic bezier yang mengikuti pergerakan kartu secara real-time.
desc.en: SVG cubic bezier rope that follows card movement in real-time.

desc.id: Card tilt mengikuti velocity drag untuk efek 3D yang natural.
desc.en: Card tilt follows drag velocity for natural 3D effect.

desc.id: Getar overshoot setelah spring-back selesai — efek fisika realistis.
desc.en: Overshoot wobble after spring-back completes — realistic physics effect.

desc.id: Copy-paste ke project Vue/Nuxt, pass props, selesai. Tanpa dependency.
desc.en: Copy-paste into any Vue/Nuxt project, pass props, done. Zero dependencies.

desc.id: Props untuk data, slots untuk custom content di foto, facts, dan footer.
desc.en: Props for data, slots for custom content in photo, facts, and footer.

desc.id: SVG gradient IDs di-uniquify via uid prop — aman kalau ada banyak kartu di satu halaman.
desc.en: SVG gradient IDs are uniquified via uid prop — safe with multiple cards on one page.

desc.id: Menggunakan Pointer Events API — works di desktop dan mobile.
desc.en: Uses Pointer Events API — works on both desktop and mobile.

desc.id: Auto-adaptif ke dark dan light mode via CSS custom properties.
desc.en: Auto-adapts to dark and light mode via CSS custom properties.

desc.id: Merancang tampilan ID card modern dengan hook, lanyard, buckle, dan card body.
desc.en: Designing a modern ID card layout with hook, lanyard, buckle, and card body.

desc.id: Implementasi cubic bezier paths yang dinamis dengan control points proporsional.
desc.en: Implementing dynamic cubic bezier paths with proportional control points.

desc.id: Membangun drag handler, rubber-band resistance, spring-back, dan velocity tracking.
desc.en: Building drag handler, rubber-band resistance, spring-back, and velocity tracking.

desc.id: Gradient overlay, glow border, shimmer stripe, weave pattern, dan wobble animation.
desc.en: Gradient overlay, glow border, shimmer stripe, weave pattern, and wobble animation.

desc.id: Refactoring ke reusable component dengan props, slots, dan unique SVG IDs.
desc.en: Refactoring into reusable component with props, slots, and unique SVG IDs.

desc.id: SVG <mask> element clips content ke viewBox bounds. Solusi: switch ke objectBoundingBox gradient tanpa mask.
desc.en: SVG <mask> element clips content to viewBox bounds. Solution: switch to objectBoundingBox gradient without mask.

desc.id: Tali harus stay anchored di hook sementara buckle bergerak. Menggunakan userSpaceOnUse coordinates + dynamic path computation.
desc.en: Rope must stay anchored at hook while buckle moves. Using userSpaceOnUse coordinates + dynamic path computation.

desc.id: Update SVG paths + transform di setiap pointer move frame. Menggunakan requestAnimationFrame + will-change: transform.
desc.en: Updating SVG paths + transform on every pointer move frame. Using requestAnimationFrame + will-change: transform.
